title: a tester-cast red ticket carries its outline check
intention: Every red or orphan ticket the tester casts carries a ran:true outline-check record, written by codemother's published 'cairn outlinecheck <id>' and committed in the same act as the cast.
why: Measured 2026-11-15: 133df5f7de08 and 8d6936a7d080 were cast by cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py (decisions[0].by = tester), and akienasus's land of each stopped at the BUILDME lane the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline because no outline check had run. red_tickets.py never calls outlinecheck.
traces_to: Law 4: a rule enforced at BUILDME is satisfied at the door that casts, not by remembering. Outline 10.3.5.1 and /sorted step 5: the check runs right after the cast.
how: In ticket_what_is_new, after the casts and before _commit, run bin/cairn outlinecheck <id> (from the code's own checkout) once per cast, sequentially. Pass env CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS={cairn: repo, CairnCommons: commons top}, plus CAIRN_REHEARSAL_CLAUDE from ROOTS['claude'] when set. On exit 0 or 1, the first stdout line is the record path: add it and each questions_opened <commons>/questions/<id>.json to the commit's named paths. On any other exit or a crash, raise a tester trouble naming the ticket and the exit, and the cast still commits. The 207c proof needs no reader: its scratch repo has no outline, so its checks fail before any read.

clauses.claim: a red ticket cast by ticket_what_is_new in a scratch world with an outline and a fake reader carries a ran:true outline-check record, and inspector.buildme_rides_the_outline_check over it names no lack
the outline-check record rides the cast's own commit and the commons is clean after the run
a run that casts three tickets makes exactly three reader calls, and no two overlap
a reader that fails still lands and commits the cast, and raises a tester trouble naming the ticket

decisions.text: D1: red_tickets runs the published outline check once per cast, sequentially, before the commit. The record and its opened questions join the named paths; a failed check raises a tester trouble and the cast still commits.
D2: the red-first proof builds the 207c world plus an outline and a fake reader script that counts calls and holds a lock file, one tooth per clause.

out: every other component; codemother's outline_check is called only through its CLI

measured.saw: 133df5f7de08 and 8d6936a7d080 were refused at the BUILDME lane the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline; both were cast by the tester
measured.how: the orchestrator's relay of akienasus's q59/q61 results; decisions[0].by in both tickets read from commons origin/main

measured.saw: the tester has made 2 cast commits on commons origin/main, each casting 1 ticket
